rows.title_full: AN ACT RIGHTSIZING THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT TO IMPROVE PUBLIC SERVICE DELIVERY
rows.abstract:
Proposes to implement a rightsizing program in the National Government for the purpose of enhancing government's institutional capacity to improve public service delivery.

Seeks to improve the quality and efficiency of government service delivery by minimizing duplication and improving performance through the rationalization of service delivery and support systems and organization structure and staffing.

Aims to ensure the long-term sustainability of our government service through resource mobilization and cost effective public expenditure management.

rows.title_full: AN ACT MODIFYING THE SALARY SCHEDULE FOR CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT PERSONNEL
rows.abstract:
Proposes the Compensation Adjustment Strategy to revise and update the existing Compensation and Position Classification System (CPCS) to reflect the changing times and make it competitive with the private sector.

States that the proposed modified Salary Schedule shall apply to all civilian personnel in the Executive, Legislative and Judicial Branches, Constitutional Commissions and other Constitutional Offices, GOCCs with original charters, not covered by R.A.10149, and a special compensation adjustment for LGU personnel.

Intended to raise the minimum salary for SG 1 from the current rate of Eleven Thousand Sixty Eight Pesos (P11,068.00) to ELEVEN THOUSAND SIX HUNDRED FIFTY SIX PESOS (P11,656.00) to make the current CPCS even more competitive with the market rates.
rows.status: Consolidated into HB05712

rows.author: G118
rows.abstract:
Aims to encourage investment by bringing down the corporate income tax (CIT), bring in the greatest benefits on the indicated fiscal incentives, create an environment of fairness and transparency in the grant of fiscal incentives, and enhance tax administration through a clear taxpayers' accountability

Proposes other salient features of the bill among others, as follows: Removing the option for corporations, including resident foreign corporations, to avail of the 15% gross income tax; Exempting HDMF from income taxation; Granting fiscal incentives only to registered activities of exporters and industries listed in the Strategic Investments Priority Plan (SIPP); Adding two (2) years of incentives for the projects located in lagging areas, areas recovering from armed conflict or major disasters, agri-business outside major urban areas or those relocated from Metro Manila and nearby urban areas; Specifying the VAT treatment shall be based on location and export sales.
rows.status: Substituted by HB04157

rows.author: G118
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 141, 142 AND 143 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8424, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997
rows.abstract:
Seeks to increase the excise tax rates on distilled spirits to 22% from 20% ad valorem on the net retail
price (NTP) per proof and a specific tax rate of P30 per liter from P23.40.

Intends to levy sparkling wines a 15% ad valorem per liter in addition to P650 specific tax per liter which
shall be increased by 7% annually, while still wines and carbonated wines with more than 14% alcohol will be taxed at P80 per liter with 7% increase annually.

Seeks to increase the specific tax rate to P28 per liter for the fermented liquors and to increase to P32 in 2020 and so on, which shall be increased by 7% annually, thereafter.
rows.status: Consolidated into HB01026
